numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across all six seasons (1-155), as on Wikipedia.

arcs.name: Sei Kyou's Rebellion
arcs.summary: War orphan Shin dreams of becoming a great general, and fate ties him to the young king Ei Sei, who has been driven from his throne.
events: Shin's friend Hyou dies after serving as the king's body double.
Shin meets Ei Sei and the mountain girl Ten.
Ei Sei allies with the mountain tribes under Yo Tan Wa and retakes the palace.

arcs.name: Battle of Dakan Plains
arcs.summary: Shin enters his first real war as a foot soldier when Wei invades Qin.
events: Shin fights in a five-man squad led by Hakuhei.
Shin kills the Wei general Kyuukou.
The great general Ou Ki appears on the battlefield.

arcs.name: Training
arcs.summary: Shin trains under Ou Ki's guidance ahead of a new campaign.
events: Ou Ki sends Shin to a lawless frontier region to fight bandits as training.
Shin learns to lead men in battle rather than only fight alone.

arcs.name: Battle of Bayou
arcs.summary: Zhao invades, and Ou Ki takes command of the Qin army at Bayou with Shin leading a hundred-man unit.
events: Ou Ki names Shin's unit the Hi Shin Unit.
Shin kills Zhao general Fuuki.
Ou Ki falls to Hou Ken and Ri Boku's scheme.

arcs.name: Alliance and the Third Faction
arcs.summary: Back in the capital, Ei Sei fights a political war against Chancellor Ryo Fui and seeks new allies in the harem.
events: Ryo Fui's faction threatens to dominate the court.
Ei Sei's past as a hostage in Zhao and his escape with Shi Ka are told.
Ei Sei wins the support of the Third Faction.

arcs.name: Sanyou Campaign
arcs.summary: Qin launches a campaign against Wei to take Sanyou, facing the legendary general Ren Pa.
events: Kyou Kai joins the Hi Shin Unit.
Shin, Ou Hon and Mou Ten fight together as three young units.
Mou Gou defeats Ren Pa's army and Qin takes Sanyou.

arcs.name: Sanyou Aftermath
arcs.summary: Qin consolidates Sanyou while the Hi Shin Unit looks for a strategist.
events: Ka Ryo Ten joins the Hi Shin Unit as its strategist.
Shin's unit is tested in smaller skirmishes.

arcs.name: Coalition Invasion
arcs.summary: Ri Boku forms an alliance of five states to march on Qin, threatening the kingdom's survival.
events: Kankoku Pass holds against the coalition.
Shin's unit fights the Chu general Ka Rin's forces.
Ei Sei rallies the people at the city of Sai and holds it until help arrives.

arcs.name: Kyou Kai's Revenge
arcs.summary: Kyou Kai seeks the assassin who killed her sister.
events: Kyou Kai returns to the Shiyuu assassin clan to confront Yu Ki, the woman who killed her sister.
Shin follows Kyou Kai and helps her survive the clan's ritual battle.

arcs.name: Conspiracy in the Court
arcs.summary: Seikyou leads a punitive force against Zhao, but his campaign is twisted into a rebellion.
events: Seikyou is framed for rebellion in Tunliu.
Shin fights to protect Seikyou and expose the plot.

arcs.name: Fire Dragons of Wei
arcs.summary: Qin attacks Wei's Chouga and faces the revived Fire Dragons, Wei's legendary generals.
events: Shin's unit faces the Wei Fire Dragons.
Ou Hon and Mou Ten fight alongside Shin.

arcs.name: State of Ai
arcs.summary: Ei Sei's coming-of-age ceremony approaches as the Queen Mother's lover Ro Ai founds a rebel state.
events: Ro Ai's forces march on Xianyang during the coronation.
The Hi Shin Unit helps defend the capital.
Ei Sei is formally crowned, and Ryo Fui steps back.

arcs.name: Battle of Kokuyou Hill
arcs.summary: Qin pushes into Zhao, with Kan Ki leading the campaign at Kokuyou Hill and Shin fighting under him.
events: Shin's unit fights across the river in Kokuyou's forests.
Kan Ki springs a trap that brings down the Zhao commander Kei Sha.
Kan Ki has the captured Zhao soldiers killed, shocking Shin.

arcs.name: Invasion of Zhao
arcs.summary: Qin launches a full-scale invasion aimed at Gyou, the gateway to Zhao's capital.
events: Ou Sen leads the three-army invasion of Zhao.
Yo Tan Wa attacks Retsubi with her mountain tribes.
Shin's unit forms an elite strike force against Zhao commanders.

filler.note: No filler: the anime adapts the manga throughout, though it skips the Assassination Plot arc and reorders some early arcs.
